title: Wheel rolling on a grounded rack
question: Drive A CW. Determine the motion of X (horizontal) and A (spin) at the shown instant. Use the labeled contact views.

answer.explanation: Drive A CW. The bottom contact has zero ground velocity. The center cancels the rotational velocity there. A positive, X positive. The requested motion is right / CW (in listed output order).

options.label: A
options.explanation: X must be right. The bottom contact has zero ground velocity. The center cancels the rotational velocity there. A positive, X positive..

options.label: B
options.explanation: All requested motions agree with the contact constraints.
